name: Coleman Research
description: Founded in 2003 and acquired by VisasQ in 2021, Coleman Research now operates as VISASQ/COLEMAN. It provides expert consultations, surveys, and custom research. Its 2026 developments include client-facing AI Scout matching and an expert recruitment team in Bogotá.
aiCapabilities: AI Scout client-facing expert matching (company says initial profiles arrive within five minutes)
AI transcriptions in the Client App (company-stated)
keyDifferentiators: Combined VisasQ and Coleman expert databases
Company-stated custom recruitment and client compliance controls

compliance.mnpiPolicy: The company prohibits disclosure of confidential and material non-public information.
compliance.expertVetting: The company says candidates undergo project eligibility and conflict screening and must provide current employment information.

overview:
Coleman Research was founded in 2003 by Kevin Coleman. VisasQ announced its acquisition in August 2021 for $102 million and completed the purchase on November 1, 2021. The combined business operates as VISASQ/COLEMAN, connecting clients with experts through consultations, surveys, and research services.

The company reports over 800,000 experts across 190 countries in its combined database as of the end of March 2026. On March 11, 2026, it launched AI Scout for clients; in August it opened an expert recruitment team in Bogotá to support its U.S. business. These are group-wide figures and developments, rather than standalone Coleman metrics.

history.narrative:
Kevin Coleman founded Coleman Research in 2003 after working at Multex, where he served as Vice President of Sales. VisasQ announced the $102 million acquisition on August 18, 2021, and completed it on November 1. Kevin Coleman joined the VisasQ board at completion.

VisasQ announced integrated branding in January 2023 and launched a U.S. Life Science team in July 2023. Its April 2024 financial presentation reported a JPY 14.472 billion goodwill impairment loss, citing lower-than-planned Coleman transaction volumes, a sluggish U.S. M&A market, competition, delays in hiring adjustments, and changes in incentive systems. In 2026, the group launched client-facing AI Scout and expanded expert recruitment to Bogotá.

timeline.event: VisasQ announced acquisition of Coleman for $102 million.
Acquisition completed on November 1; Kevin Coleman joined the VisasQ board.
VisasQ announced integrated branding with Coleman on January 31.
VisasQ launched a specialized Life Science team in the U.S.
VisasQ reported a JPY 14.472 billion goodwill impairment loss in its FY2023 results presentation.
AI Scout launched for clients on March 11; the company says it delivers initial expert profiles within five minutes.
Bogotá expert recruitment team began operations on August 3 to support the U.S. business.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: One-on-one online or in-person consultations for due diligence, idea generation, industry education, and channel checks. The company says it custom-recruits experts for client projects.

servicesDetailed.name: Custom Research Projects
servicesDetailed.description: The acquisition completion announcement describes research support covering research design, expert interviews, and report preparation using the combined databases.

servicesDetailed.name: Survey Services
servicesDetailed.description: Customizable online questionnaires. The company says its team identifies requirements, vets respondents within and beyond its network, and designs and administers surveys.

servicesDetailed.name: Life Sciences Expert Access
servicesDetailed.description: VisasQ launched a U.S. Life Science team in July 2023 to develop its expert coverage in that field.

servicesDetailed.name: Cross-Border Research
servicesDetailed.description: The combined business uses VisasQ and Coleman databases for overseas research. The company describes collaboration between regional teams to recruit and schedule experts.

servicesDetailed.name: Hosted Events & Seminars
servicesDetailed.description: Industry discussions with expert speakers. The company provides free access to seminar transcripts and recordings.

aiPlatform.narrative: VISASQ/COLEMAN launched AI Scout for clients on March 11, 2026, after using it internally. Clients email a project scope and receive proposed expert profiles. The company says initial matches arrive within five minutes, with 24/7 availability. Its current product page describes AI Scout as complementing a dedicated account team and human oversight; the timing and quality claims are company-stated.
features: AI analysis of project requirements and expert matching
Client App project submission, expert review, scheduling, and AI transcriptions

complianceExtended.narrative: The company describes a compliance program with an internal legal department, project-level eligibility screening, and training and terms acceptance required within each rolling 12-month period. These are published company policies, not an independent assessment of their effectiveness.
highlights: Company policies restrict discussion of current employers and confidential information
Restricted-company policies integrated into workflow software
Company says its Compliance App provides historical consultation data for audits and blocks scheduling when client requirements are unmet

clientFit.narrative: Editorial assessment: the combination of expert interviews, surveys, and cross-border sourcing may suit investors, consulting firms, and corporations conducting primary research. Buyers considering AI Scout should distinguish initial profile recommendations from completed consultations.
segments: Asset managers and hedge funds conducting investment research
Consulting firms seeking expert interviews and surveys

strengths: Combined VisasQ and Coleman databases for cross-border research
Company reports one in five consultations involves a custom-recruited expert, with average recruiting time under 24 hours
Published compliance controls and client oversight tools
Client-facing AI Scout alongside account-team support
caveats: Expert counts and recruitment and AI matching speed metrics are company-reported, not independently validated here
The JPY 14.472 billion goodwill impairment reported in April 2024 is a historical financial event
Public pages reviewed did not establish client pricing, standard cooling-off periods, or a current combined employee count
notableFacts: Acquired by VisasQ in November 2021 following an August announcement
VisasQ reported Coleman transaction volume above $43 million and over 260,000 experts at acquisition in 2021
VisasQ announced integrated branding with Coleman in January 2023
A U.S. Life Science team launched in July 2023
AI Scout became client-facing in March 2026
Bogotá recruitment operations began in August 2026
